run_gen_texmean: run the tex mean extraction script with a config path to generate color_mean.png
run_main_pipeline: run the main function to extract texture mean from fully lit body dataset frames
create_BodyDataset: create a BodyDataset instance from config data to load body frames and cameras
create_GeometryModule: create a GeometryModule with mesh topology vertices, UV coordinates, and face indices
create_LBSModule: create an LBSModule with a skinning model JSON and template mesh for pose deformation
